verdict.rationale: Crossplane installs via Helm into your own Kubernetes cluster, so its control-plane state lives wherever you choose to run it. It also manages cloud resources such as AWS RDS instances and is described as portable across cloud providers, which implies you pick where provisioned resources live. The evidence never explicitly documents region or residency selection, so this rests on implication rather than a stated feature. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of region/location fields on managed resources, any data-residency statement, and independent corroboration of residency control.
